confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Da Nang price levels, not live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are the more reliable; hotel anchors vary most with season and location, and July is peak beach season. The FX observation comes from the RBA Exchange Rates Overview page as surfaced in search results. I did not open the F11 table directly, and the 2026-10-16 third-party rate was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Vietnamese coastal tourism cities with similar price levels, mainly Hoi An, Nha Trang and central Vietnam generally, adjusted for Da Nang's beach-resort hotel demand in peak season.
